idea: Themed weeks, week four, Know your states day: written from the source, then corrected by a numbers editor; a viewer editor read an earlier version and changed nothing, before voicing.
description: In FY 2024-25 Himachal Pradesh generated 39,386 million units of large-hydro electricity, 26.5% of India's 1,48,634 million units and the highest of the states. Jammu and Kashmir had 10.2%, Uttarakhand 10.2% and Karnataka 9.5%; Madhya Pradesh followed with 5.1%.

Of all the electricity generated in India, Himachal made 2.3%: 42,534 of 18,24,214 million units, and 93% of its own was large hydro. Its share of India's large hydro was between 24% and 27% in each of the six years from 2020-21 to 2025-26. Large hydro here means plants over 25 MW. It is electricity generated in the state, not who owns or uses it, and not capacity. State totals, not per person.
source: Ministry of Power, reply to Lok Sabha Starred Q 284 of 12 March 2026, Annexure-II (Central Electricity Authority data): electricity generated by source and state, million units, FY 2024-25 (all-India large hydro 1,48,633.98; all sources 18,24,213.76, excluding imports). 'Large hydro' is the answer's column; plants over 25 MW are large under the Ministry of Power's classification. 2025-26 share: MNRE reply to Lok Sabha Q 1668, 29 July 2026 (CEA). Generation in the state, not capacity. State totals, not per person.
